text: Session wrap-up: PR #5416 (#5401, stop() exception-safety) merged as 517589e6a after 3 adversarial review rounds -- ResetOnExit RAII guard, a redundant-relock race in its own destructor, and an unguarded process-wide test hook (fixed with a new COPPERFIN_ENABLE_WORKSPACE_AGENT_SESSION_TEST_HOOKS macro matching the cf_runtime_pipeline convention, verified via nm against a tests-disabled build). PR #5417 (#5405, path-predicate consolidation) merged as 7a6155cbd, clean on first review. PR #5418 (#5408, ScopedFd/ScopedHandle consolidation) merged as fc7357766 after a real windows.h include-order bug (round-1 review) and a Windows-CI-only failure local testing couldn't catch: the new scoped_resource.h lived under the public include/ tree with #if defined(_WIN32) class bodies, tripping test_platform_sqlite_api_boundary_contract's public-header platform-token scan -- fixed by relocating to src/platform/scoped_resource.h, matching the existing bounded_process_private.h/sqlite_api.h precedent. Worth remembering: new shared headers with per-platform bodies belong under src/, not include/copperfin/, unless the platform branching is pushed into the .cpp like path.h does. All three issues (#5401, #5405, #5408) closed manually since v1-development isn't the default branch. Checked the I2/#34 issue tree afterward: only #5403 (policy question, needs owner decision) and #5409 (read_physically_contained_file_snapshot() reopen-by-string architecture, re-confirmed too large for one slice -- needs a real API-shape redesign across 4+ call sites) remain open, neither self-selectable. Full detail in agent-handoff.md.
